title: Google Docs voice typing vs Willow Voice: Mac dictation options for 2026
metaTitle: Google Docs voice typing vs Willow Voice: Which is better for Mac?
description: Compare Google Docs voice typing and Willow Voice. See how they stack up for Mac users, and find out if Lazur fits your workflow better.
targetKeyword: google docs voice typing vs willow voice
intro: Google Docs voice typing is a free browser-based tool for simple drafting, while Willow Voice is a system-wide AI assistant that works in any app. If you need more than just basic transcription on your Mac, you might find both limited compared to a screen-aware assistant like Lazur.
tldr: Google Docs voice typing is free but restricted to the web browser.
Willow Voice offers system-wide dictation and AI drafting across various apps.
Lazur provides system-wide dictation plus screen-aware guidance and research.
Choose Google for free, simple tasks in Docs.
Choose Willow for cross-app dictation and AI writing.
Choose Lazur for a complete Mac assistant that sees your screen.

blocks.text: Google Docs voice typing is a built-in feature for Google Chrome, Edge, and Safari users. You access it inside a document by clicking Tools > Voice typing. It is entirely free and requires no subscription. However, it only works within the browser tab where you have a Google Doc or Slide open. If you click into Slack or an email, the microphone stops working immediately.

Because it relies on your browser, you cannot use it for system-wide tasks. You cannot fill out a form in a desktop app or dictate into a terminal window. Furthermore, all your audio is sent to Google servers in real-time. This means you must have an active internet connection to use it. If your Wi-Fi drops, your dictation stops.
How Willow Voice differs from standard tools

Willow Voice is a dedicated Mac application. It installs on your system and acts as an overlay. This allows it to function in every text field you encounter. Whether you are typing in a code editor, a messaging app, or a web browser, Willow Voice is active. It also includes Scribe AI, which helps you draft content based on spoken intent rather than just transcribing raw speech.

Willow Voice processes speech in the cloud to maintain high accuracy. While they offer enterprise features like zero-data retention for business users, individual users should be aware that their data is handled by external servers. Always check your settings to see what history is being stored on your account.
Why Lazur is different for Mac users

Lazur is not just a dictation tool. It lives in your Mac menu bar notch and sees your screen. While you can hold the fn key to dictate clean text anywhere, you can also hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask questions about what is on your screen. Lazur will answer out loud and even point at the specific button or menu item you are looking for.
Everyday use cases for your Mac

If you are struggling with a complex app, ask Lazur to guide you through a workflow. It will wait for you to perform each step. It also handles background research by opening its own Chrome tabs, summarizing the results, and bringing back a report. This saves you from manually searching and copying text.

faq.question: Is Google Docs voice typing free?
faq.answer: Yes, it is included with any standard Google account at no cost.

faq.question: Does Willow Voice work offline?
faq.answer: Yes, it offers offline dictation on select Apple hardware.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons for me?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons or operate other apps. It points at things and guides you so you can perform the action yourself.

faq.question: Which tool is best for privacy?
faq.answer: Lazur processes audio and screen data only while you hold the shortcut and does not store it to train AI models. Google and Willow have their own cloud-based data policies you should review.

verdict: If you only need to dictate text into Google Docs, the free built-in tool is fine. If you need to dictate in other apps, Willow Voice is a strong choice. For Mac users who want a tool that understands what is on their screen and helps them navigate their work, Lazur is the better fit.
